MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next purchase because it would let my existing Alexa devices control a compatible lamp, adding a function I do not already have.",
    "The Show 8's larger screen interests me because I already use an Alexa display, though that interest does not mean I need another display now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Older Echo Dots and the first-generation Show 5 duplicate devices I recently bought in newer generations, so they offer little practical benefit to me.",
    "The streaming sticks repeat what my recent 4K Max bundle already does; a different remote cover does not create a new need.",
    "The older Fire tablet does not connect to a current need, and I have no specific place where another Alexa speaker would be useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to keep buying Alexa speakers and displays, even when their functions are already covered.",
    "My Fire TV purchase seems to have been taken as ongoing interest in more streaming sticks, rather than a purchase that satisfied that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The timing and generations of my recent purchases matter: I already have a fourth-generation Dot, a second-generation Show 5, and a 4K Max.",
    "My Show 5 stand and Harmony replacement batteries suggest that useful additions to equipment I own can matter more to me than another similar device.",
    "A larger screen can catch my attention without being worth buying while my recently purchased display still meets my needs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in Alexa and home electronics, but missed that I currently want useful additions more than duplicate devices."
}
